mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project) AS totalProjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project WHERE project_status = 'ON_SALE') AS onSaleProjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_project WHERE project_status = 'COMING_SOON') AS comingSoonProjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_session) AS sessionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_session WHERE session_status = 'ON_SALE') AS onSaleSessionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_sku) AS skuCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sku.stock_available), 0) FROM ticket_sku sku JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = sku.session_id JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = sku.project_id WHERE sku.sku_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') AND s.session_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') AND p.project_status <> 'OFFLINE') AS stockAvailableCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(stock_locked), 0) FROM ticket_sku) AS stockLockedCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sold_count), 0) FROM ticket_sku) AS soldCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order) AS orderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order WHERE order_status = 'WAIT_PAY') AS waitPayOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order WHERE order_status = 'WAIT_USE') AS waitUseOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order WHERE order_status = 'FINISHED') AS finishedOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order WHERE order_status = 'REFUNDING') AS refundingOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order WHERE order_status = 'REFUND_SUCCESS') AS refundSuccessOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_account) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayOrderCount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM ticket_order WHERE order_status IN ('WAIT_USE', 'FINISHED', 'REFUNDING', 'REFUND_SUCCESS')) AS paidOrderAmount, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM ticket_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(pay_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayPaidAmount
